scope: authenticated high-traffic read paths and the jobs in-memory catalog

productionBaseline.source: Sites Worker aggregate logs captured before this deployment
productionBaseline.note: These are pre-change application and Worker timings, not post-change claims.

environment.database: fresh node:sqlite D1 compatibility adapter per sample
environment.data: repository migrations and seed with 119 public jobs

before.scope: direct paged GET /jobs after the preceding D1 round-trip remediation

interpretation: The existing direct paged route retained one D1 dispatch without a material controlled-latency regression.
The catalog bootstrap is a new request shape, so no before/after percentage is claimed for it.
After catalog hydration, jobs filter, search, sort, saved-only, calendar-month, and list/calendar view changes issue zero read requests; regression tests verify this behavior.

validation.typecheck: pass for contracts, UI, API, web, docs, and Sites

limitations: Controlled benchmark timings exclude production network and D1 latency.
Post-deployment production latency is not claimed until new production requests exist.
The first visit still includes authentication, HTML and JavaScript download, and platform cold-start variability.
The catalog is user-personalized and retained only in that browser's authenticated React Query memory; it is not shared through a public HTTP cache.
